content.problemStatement:
You receive an array of `k` linked-lists `lists`, each linked-list is sorted in ascending order.

*Merge all the linked-lists into one sorted linked-list and output it.*
constraints: lists[i] is sorted in ascending order.
The sum of lists[i].length will not exceed 10^4.
content.inputFormat: Single line: JSON array of all arguments, e.g. [arg1, arg2, ...]

sampleTestCases.explanation:
The linked-lists are:
[
  1->4->5,
  1->3->4,
  2->6
]
merging them into one sorted linked list:
1->1->2->3->4->4->5->6
Applying the rules of Merge k Sorted Lists to this input produces [].
Applying the rules of Merge k Sorted Lists to this input produces [].

hidden.label: Lists supplied in descending range order
Negative zero positive values with duplicates
Value boundaries including minimum and maximum
Mixed empty and uneven list lengths
Two long lists meeting at zero
Maximum k=10000 with one non-empty list
Maximum total nodes with ten large lists
Many empty lists plus maximum-length list
Maximum total nodes with duplicate-heavy lists

solution.approach: The approach uses a divide-and-conquer technique, merging two lists at a time to reduce the problem size.
